decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: Drawing numbers CHPH SL01, CHPH SL01 REV A, CHPH EX01, CHPH PE01 REV A, CHPH PE02 REV B, CHPH PE03; Flood Risk Assessment referenced R0870 FRA-v2 dated July 2025; Drainage Strategy referenced R0870 -Rev - V1 dated July 2025; Design and Access Statement referenced CHPH DAS dated 1 April 2025; Bat Assessment and Habitat Enhancement Report prepared by Ecology Resources dated 7 June 2023.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed on side elevations at the extension(s) hereby permitted, without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

The development hereby permitted shall not proceed beyond damp proof course level until the following has been submitted to, and approved by, the Council:(a) Privacy screening for the rear raised patio along the flanks.The proposed development shall be installed and retained as per the approved details thereafter.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015  (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order with or without modification), no development which would otherwise fall within Classes A, B and D in Part 1 of Schedule 2 to that Order shall be carried out without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.

The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension(s) hereby permitted shall match the appearance of those used in the host dwellinghouse only, unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

The development hereby permitted shall not be commenced until a drainage plan demonstrating separate disposal for sewage and stormwater has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The development shall be constructed and retained in accordance with those approved details.

The development hereby permitted shall not proceed beyond damp proof course level until the following:(a) The applicant provides to the Council for approval in writing details and drawings of the incorporation within the fabric of the extended building of:i. 3 Schwegler 2FR interconnecting bat tubes (or similarly durable functional equivalent) mounted side by side, to permit bats to move between them, on the southern aspect of the building at just below roof eaves level;ii. 2 universal bird bricks to be mounted on the eastern aspect of the building at just below roof eaves level.(b) The applicant will install the wildlife shelters in accordance with this approval and retain them thereafter, ensuring that the entrance holes and access ways remain clear.(c) Prior to completion, the applicant will provide to the Council photos of the provided shelters in position.
description: Alterations to bay windows in ground floor front elevation; Single and two storey side extension; Single and two storey rear extension; Replacement windows in front, side and rear elevations,  Alterations to roof to raise ridge height and form rear dormers, Roof lights in front and side roof slopes; Extended raised patio at the rear with balustrade and steps (Demolition of side extension)
